comparison.objective: Screen a dry media/workpiece mixture, versus pegging a T-shirt onto a clothesline.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load sharing and granular-flow control versus opening spring pegs and clamping deformable cloth to a line.
comparison.success_condition: Media in receiver, washers in screen and no loss versus shirt securely suspended by pegs.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual handling is generic; the record does not test separation or orientation-dependent particle flow.
